name: Life Time Miami Marathon
summary: The Life Time Miami Marathon is held in late January or early February. It starts and finishes near Biscayne Boulevard and Bayfront Park. The course crosses the MacArthur Causeway to Miami Beach and returns on the Venetian Causeway. The official site says it is almost all flat, apart from a few bridges.
courseHighlights: Start on Biscayne Boulevard in front of the Kaseya Center
MacArthur Causeway, the largest bridge, about a quarter mile in
Brickell, Coconut Grove and the Rickenbacker Causeway toward Key Biscayne

paceStrategy.summary: The course is almost all flat, so even pacing is the plan. The bridges are short inclines. Warm, humid weather is the usual risk, so start at a controlled pace.

segments.terrain: MacArthur Causeway, the course's largest bridge, then a second incline near mile 2.5
segments.advice: Take the bridges easy and hold back.

segments.terrain: South Beach, Ocean Drive, Venetian Causeway, South Miami Avenue bridge at mile 13.2
segments.advice: Settle to goal pace; run the small inclines by effort.

segments.terrain: Marathon continues south: Brickell, Coconut Grove, toward Key Biscayne
segments.advice: Keep an even pace; the road is flat.

segments.terrain: Return through Brickell and downtown Miami, finish at Bayfront Park
segments.advice: Keep an even effort and push in the final mile.

fuelingNotes: The official page says there are numerous aid stations but does not list their positions. Plan to take water at every station if it is warm, and take a gel before the bridge at mile 13.2.
tips: Corrals open at 5:00 am and the race starts early, so plan your transport and arrive in good time
Short bridge inclines come at about mile 0.25, 2.5 and 13.2
Heat and humidity rise quickly after sunrise, so drink early
The finish is four blocks south of the start, which makes meeting friends easy

faq.question: Is the Miami Marathon flat?
faq.answer: Yes. The official site says the course is almost all flat, apart from a few bridges including the MacArthur Causeway and the South Miami Avenue bridge.

faq.question: Where does the Miami Marathon start and finish?
faq.answer: It starts on Biscayne Boulevard in front of the Kaseya Center and finishes at Bayfront Park, four blocks south.

faq.question: When is the Miami Marathon held?
faq.answer: It is typically held on the last Sunday in January or the first Sunday in February.
